scopeNote: Drafts per company, store, user and device. Approvals here do not change other modules.
name: Description / name
invalid: Check the fields and try again.
storageError: Could not read or save. Preserve your data and try again.
conflict: Another window changed the data. Refresh before saving.
exceeds: Amount exceeds the open balance or is invalid.
belowCost: Discount would reduce the price below the entered cost.
matchInvalid: Amounts, type or an existing link prevent matching.
transition: This stage change is not allowed.
noAccess: Your profile cannot access this area.
cashBasis: Result from recorded receipts and payments; does not replace an accrual-based accounting statement.
confirmAction: Confirm this change to the local draft?
imported: File imported, tax status not checked
fiscalNote: Importing XML does not prove authenticity or record stock receipt. Issuing, cancellation and number invalidation require an authorized fiscal service.
needsBackend: Available after server integration and authorization.
legacySAT: SP: CF-e-SAT is legacy; new issuance has been prohibited since 2026-01-01.
connectionNote: These preferences do not connect providers. Credentials will be entered through the secure server flow, never this local record.
inventoryNote: This count prepares a review. Official stock changes only through the authorized stock flow. Entered values are not queried stock balances.
pcpNote: Orders and capacity below come from recipe planning, not official stock movements.
campaignNote: Simulation blocks prices below entered cost. Campaigns do not change POS prices; application and cashback need integration.
channelNote: Orders are manually entered to prepare the flow. No automatic capture, official reservation or marketplace transmission occurs.
branchNote: Preparation record. Changing the real context requires server authorization; selecting a row does not switch company or mix data.
taskNote: Alerts below are derived from local tasks and deadlines. Fiscal rejection, cash or stock events need module sources.
backup: Export encrypted backup of this workspace
passwordLength: Use a password with 12 to 256 characters.
invalidBackup: Password, file or context mismatch. Nothing was restored.
backupNote: Includes only drafts from this workspace, not the official database, other modules, certificates or passwords. File password is not stored.
erase: Erase this workspace’s drafts on this device
eraseConfirm: Erase this workspace’s local drafts and versions? Official server data is unaffected.
sourceError: Could not query this source. Try refreshing.
accessNote: The list uses real access records. Creation or revocation stays in the authorized screen. Activity below covers only this workspace, not server audit.
unsaved: There are unsaved fields. Leave and discard them?
posNote: Sales and cash stay in the existing integrated flow. Payment and fiscal document keep separate states; a screen is not evidence of operation.
operationalNote: Operational status requires evidence of flow, persistence, permission, isolation, audit and restoration.
_review: pt-BR source; en/es/fr/zh-CN require native review before production.
posCheckNote: This check reads existing data without creating sales. It does not prove a complete sale, restoration, fiscal operation or integrated payment.
loyaltyNote: Local rules and simulation. No customer balance or POS cashback is created.
